digest.component_or_area: rebar engine reconciler, LLM eval framework, metrics registry
propositions: timeout_s parameter in _call_with_retry signature is declared and documented but never read, causing callers intending it for wrapped Jira client to have it swallowed instead of forwarded through **kwargs
run_eval dirty parameter is declared but never read and no caller passes it, falsely implying eval-provenance source can be switched

module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend metric seeds are permanently Unavailable due to _no_data_yet compute function, blocking future real implementations from registering under those ids due to existing-id check
Deleting timeout_s parameter restores natural behavior allowing it to flow through kwargs to wrapped function
Deleting dirty parameter removes false capability signal with no caller using it
Removing placeholder metric seeds and test_trend_unavailable frees ids for future implementations and eliminates stub-pinning test
